name: ADBICA
summary: ADBICA (also known as ADB-PICA) is a designer drug identified in synthetic cannabis blends in Japan in 2013. ADBICA had not previously been reported in the scientific literature prior to its sale as a component of synthetic cannabis blends. ADBICA features a carboxamide group at the 3-indole position, like SDB-001 and STS-135.

pharmacology.text: ADBICA is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and CB2 receptor with an EC50 value of 0.69 nM and 1.8 nM respectively.

uses.text: ADBICA (also known as ADB-PICA) is a designer drug identified in synthetic cannabis blends in Japan in 2013.

summaryZh: ADBICA，化學名N-(1-氨甲醯基-2,2-二甲基丙基)-1-戊基吲哚-3-甲醯胺（英語：N--1-pentyl-1H-indole-3-carboxamide，也稱為 ADB-PICA）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C20H29N3O2，屬於3-吲哚甲醯胺衍生物，可作為合成大麻素，2013年在日本發現，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。
summaryZhHans: ADBICA，化学名N-(1-氨甲酰基-2,2-二甲基丙基)-1-戊基吲哚-3-甲酰胺（英语：N--1-pentyl-1H-indole-3-carboxamide，也称为 ADB-PICA）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C20H29N3O2，属于3-吲哚甲酰胺衍生物，可作为合成大麻素，2013年在日本发现，2015年列入《非药用类麻醉药品和精神药品名录》。
